    Solver options #

    The options a solver accepts, as data rather than as strings. Solver.Option has one variant per category, each wrapping that category's own inductive, and Solver.Option.argType is the type of the value an option expects: Bool for a flag, Nat or Int for a number, and a dedicated inductive for an option taking one of a fixed set of modes. Solver.Option.toStrings produces the flag and value cvc5's string-based setOption wants.

    Each option is also an abbreviation on Solver.Option named after its category and itself, so .smt_produceModels can be written for .smt .produceModels.

    The options are cvc5's own, minus three kinds:

    • those cvc5 reserves for experts;
    • those of its command-line driver and of its parser (help, version, interactive, force-logic, lang, …), which mean nothing to a solver driven through its API;
    • quiet and verbose, which only step the verbosity, verbosity setting it directly.

    The categories follow cvc5's own modules, with two departures: every sygus-* option is gathered into Solver.Option.Sygus wherever cvc5 declares it, and decision is an SMT-layer option rather than the only member of a category of its own.

    inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Base.Output :
    Type

    Output tags, each enabling one kind of diagnostic output.

    • inst : Output

      inst: Print instantiations during solving.

    • instStrategy : Output

      inst-strategy: Prints a summary of the instantiation techniques as they are run.

    • oracles : Output

      oracles: Print calls to oracles and responses received.

    • sygus : Output

      sygus: Print enumerated terms and candidates generated by the sygus solver.

    • sygusGrammar : Output

      sygus-grammar: Print grammars automatically generated by the sygus solver.

    • sygusEnumerator : Output

      sygus-enumerator: Print enumerators generated by the sygus solver.

    • sygusSolGterm : Output

      sygus-sol-gterm.

      Print annotations for terms in sygus solutions that indicate the grammar used to generate them.

    • trigger : Output

      trigger: Print selected triggers for quantified formulas.

    • rawBenchmark : Output

      raw-benchmark: Print the benchmark back on the output verbatim as it is processed.

    • learnedLits : Output

      learned-lits: Print input literals that hold globally.

    • subs : Output

      subs: Print top-level substitutions learned during preprocessing.

    • postAsserts : Output

      post-asserts.

      Print a benchmark corresponding to the assertions of the input problem after preprocessing.

    • preAsserts : Output

      pre-asserts.

      Print a benchmark corresponding to the assertions of the input problem before preprocessing.

    • deepRestart : Output

      deep-restart.

      Print when cvc5 performs a deep restart along with the literals it has learned.

    • incomplete : Output

      incomplete: Print reason why cvc5 answers unknown for any given check-sat query.

    • lemmas : Output

      lemmas: Print lemmas as they are added to the SAT solver.

    • trustedProofSteps : Output

      trusted-proof-steps: Print formulas corresponding to trusted proof steps in final proofs.

    • timeoutCoreBenchmark : Output

      timeout-core-benchmark.

      Print the corresponding benchmark when successfully computing a timeout core.

    • unsatCoreBenchmark : Output

      unsat-core-benchmark.

      Print the corresponding benchmark when successfully computing an unsat core.

    • unsatCoreLemmasBenchmark : Output

      unsat-core-lemmas-benchmark.

      Print the corresponding benchmark when successfully computing an unsat core with theory lemmas.

    • unsatCoreLemmas : Output

      unsat-core-lemmas.

      Print diagnostic information on lemmas that appear in an unsat core with theory lemmas.

    • portfolio : Output

      portfolio: Prints the option strings tried in portfolio mode.

    • blockModel : Output

      block-model: Prints the formulas used when block-model is run.

    • optionsAuto : Output

      options-auto: Prints the options set during automatic configuration.

    • rareDb : Output

      rare-db.

      Upon initialization, print the set of (non-expert) RARE rewrite rules as they are defined in the proof signature.

    • rareDbExpert : Output

      rare-db-expert.

      Upon initialization, print the set of expert RARE rewrite rules as they are defined in the proof signature.

          inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Base :
          Type

          Resource limits, verbosity, statistics and incrementality.

          • incremental : Base

            --incremental: Enable incremental solving.

          • output : Base

            --output: Enable output tag.

          • parseOnly : Base

            --parse-only: Exit after parsing input.

          • preprocessOnly : Base

            --preprocess-only: Exit after preprocessing input.

          • rlimit : Base

            --rlimit: Set resource limit.

          • rlimitPer : Base

            --rlimit-per: Set resource limit per query.

          • stats : Base

            --stats: Give statistics on exit.

          • statsAll : Base

            --stats-all: Print unchanged (defaulted) statistics as well.

          • statsInternal : Base

            --stats-internal: Print internal (non-public) statistics as well.

          • tlimit : Base

            --tlimit: Set time limit in milliseconds of wall clock time.

          • tlimitPer : Base

            --tlimit-per: Set time limit per query in milliseconds.

          • verbosity : Base

            --verbosity: The verbosity level of cvc5.

          • seed : Base

            --seed: Seed for random number generator.

          • statsEveryQuery : Base

            --stats-every-query.

            In incremental mode, print stats after every satisfiability or validity query.

                          inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Smt.InterpolantsMode :
                          Type

                          Interpolants grammar mode.

                          • default : InterpolantsMode

                            default: Use the default grammar for the theory or the user-defined grammar if given.

                          • assumptions : InterpolantsMode

                            assumptions: Use only operators that occur in the assumptions.

                          • conjecture : InterpolantsMode

                            conjecture: Use only operators that occur in the conjecture.

                          • shared : InterpolantsMode

                                                  inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Smt :
                                                  Type

                                                  The SMT layer: what a check can produce, self-checks, preprocessing.

                                                  • decision : Smt

                                                    --decision: Choose decision mode.

                                                  • checkAbducts : Smt

                                                    --check-abducts: Checks whether produced solutions to get-abduct are correct.

                                                  • checkInterpolants : Smt

                                                    --check-interpolants: Checks whether produced solutions to get-interpolant are correct.

                                                  • checkModelSubsolver : Smt

                                                    --check-model-subsolver.

                                                    Use subsolver to compute values when applicable in calls to get-value and check-models.

                                                  • checkModels : Smt

                                                    --check-models.

                                                    After SAT/INVALID/UNKNOWN, check that the generated model satisfies user assertions.

                                                  • checkProofs : Smt

                                                    --check-proofs: After UNSAT/VALID, check the generated proof (with proof).

                                                  • checkSynthSol : Smt

                                                    --check-synth-sol.

                                                    Checks whether produced solutions to functions-to-synthesize satisfy the conjecture.

                                                  • checkUnsatCores : Smt

                                                    --check-unsat-cores: After UNSAT/VALID, produce and check an unsat core (expensive).

                                                  • debugCheckModels : Smt

                                                    --debug-check-models.

                                                    After SAT/INVALID/UNKNOWN, check that the generated model satisfies user and internal assertions.

                                                  • produceModels : Smt

                                                    --produce-models: Support the get-value and get-model commands.

                                                  • produceProofs : Smt

                                                    --produce-proofs: Produce proofs, support check-proofs and get-proof.

                                                  • produceUnsatCores : Smt

                                                    --produce-unsat-cores.

                                                    Turn on unsat core generation. Unless otherwise specified, cores will be produced using SAT soving under assumptions and preprocessing proofs.

                                                  • interpolantsMode : Smt

                                                    --interpolants-mode: Choose interpolants production mode.

                                                  • learnedRewrite : Smt

                                                    --learned-rewrite: Rewrite the input based on learned literals.

                                                  • modelCores : Smt

                                                    --model-cores: Mode for producing model cores.

                                                  • printCoresFull : Smt

                                                    --print-cores-full.

                                                    Print all formulas regardless of whether they are named, e.g. in unsat cores.

                                                  • produceAbducts : Smt

                                                    --produce-abducts: Support the get-abduct command.

                                                  • produceAssertions : Smt

                                                    --produce-assertions: Keep an assertions list. Note this option is always enabled.

                                                  • produceAssignments : Smt

                                                    --produce-assignments: Support the get-assignment command.

                                                  • produceDifficulty : Smt

                                                    --produce-difficulty: Enable tracking of difficulty.

                                                  • produceInterpolants : Smt

                                                    --produce-interpolants: Turn on interpolation generation.

                                                  • produceLearnedLiterals : Smt

                                                    --produce-learned-literals: Produce learned literals, support get-learned-literals.

                                                  • produceUnsatAssumptions : Smt

                                                    --produce-unsat-assumptions: Turn on unsat assumptions generation.

                                                  • simplification : Smt

                                                    --simplification: Choose simplification mode.

                                                  • solveBvAsInt : Smt

                                                    --solve-bv-as-int: Mode for translating BVAnd to integer.

                                                  • solveIntAsBv : Smt

                                                    --solve-int-as-bv.

                                                    Attempt to solve a pure integer satisfiable problem by bitblasting in sufficient bitwidth (experimental).

                                                  • solveRealAsInt : Smt

                                                    --solve-real-as-int.

                                                    Attempt to solve a pure real satisfiable problem as an integer problem (for non-linear).

                                                  • staticLearning : Smt

                                                    --static-learning: Use static learning (on by default).

                                                                                                                                                                inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Arith :
                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                The arithmetic theory.

                                                                                                                                                                • brab : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --arith-brab: Whether to use simple rounding, similar to a unit-cube test, for integers.

                                                                                                                                                                • rewriteEqualities : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --arith-rewrite-equalities.

                                                                                                                                                                  Turns on the preprocessing rewrite turning equalities into a conjunction of inequalities.

                                                                                                                                                                • staticLearning : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --arith-static-learning.

                                                                                                                                                                  Do arithmetic static learning for ite terms based on bounds when static learning is enabled.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlCov : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-cov.

                                                                                                                                                                  Whether to use the cylindrical algebraic coverings solver for non-linear arithmetic.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlCovLinearModel : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-cov-linear-model.

                                                                                                                                                                  Whether to use the linear model as initial guess for the cylindrical algebraic coverings solver.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExt : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext: Incremental linearization approach to non-linear.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtFactor : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-factor: Use factoring inference in non-linear incremental linearization solver.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtFlattenMon : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-flatten-mon: Use inference schema based on flattening monomials.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtRewrite : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-rewrite.

                                                                                                                                                                  Do context-dependent simplification based on rewrites in non-linear solver.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtTfTplanes : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-tf-tplanes.

                                                                                                                                                                  Use non-terminating tangent plane strategy for transcendental functions for non-linear incremental linearization solver.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtTplanes : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-tplanes.

                                                                                                                                                                  Use non-terminating tangent plane strategy for non-linear incremental linearization solver.

                                                                                                                                                                • nlExtTplanesInterleave : Arith

                                                                                                                                                                  --nl-ext-tplanes-interleave.

                                                                                                                                                                  Interleave tangent plane strategy for non-linear incremental linearization solver.

                                                                                                                                                                                          inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Bv.BoolToBv :
                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                          BoolToBV preprocessing pass modes.

                                                                                                                                                                                          • off : BoolToBv

                                                                                                                                                                                            off: Don't push any booleans to width one bit-vectors (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                          • ite : BoolToBv

                                                                                                                                                                                            ite.

                                                                                                                                                                                            Try to turn ITEs into BITVECTOR_ITE when possible. It can fail per-formula if not all sub-formulas can be turned to bit-vectors.

                                                                                                                                                                                          • all : BoolToBv

                                                                                                                                                                                            all.

                                                                                                                                                                                            Force all booleans to be bit-vectors of width one except at the top level. Most aggressive mode.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Strings.ProcessLoopMode :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Loop processing modes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • full : ProcessLoopMode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              full: Perform full processing of looping word equations (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • simple : ProcessLoopMode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              simple: Omit normal loop breaking (default with --strings-fmf).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • simpleAbort : ProcessLoopMode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              simple-abort: Abort when normal loop breaking is required.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • none : ProcessLoopMode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              none: Omit loop processing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • abort : ProcessLoopMode

                                                                                                                                                                                                                              abort: Abort if looping word equations are encountered.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Strings :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The theory of strings and sequences.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • reElim : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --re-elim: Regular expression elimination mode.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • checkEntailLen : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-check-entail-len: Check entailment between length terms to reduce splitting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • deqExt : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-deq-ext: Use extensionality for string disequalities.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • eagerEval : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-eager-eval.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Perform eager context-dependent evaluation for applications of string kinds in the equality engine.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • eagerLenRe : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-eager-len-re: Use regular expressions for eager length conflicts.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • eagerSolver : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-eager-solver: Use the eager solver.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • exp : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-exp: Experimental features in the theory of strings.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • fmf : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-fmf: The finite model finding used by the theory of strings.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • lazyPp : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-lazy-pp: Perform string preprocessing lazily.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • mbr : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-mbr.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Use models to avoid reductions for extended functions that introduce quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • processLoopMode : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-process-loop-mode: Determines how to process looping string equations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • regexpInclusion : Strings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --strings-regexp-inclusion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Use regular expression inclusion for finding conflicts and avoiding regular expression unfolding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Uf.Ss :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Values of --uf-ss.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            UF with cardinality options currently supported by the --uf-ss option when combined with finite model finding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • full : Ss

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              full.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Default, use UF with cardinality to find minimal models for uninterpreted sorts (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • noMinimal : Ss

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              no-minimal: Use UF with cardinality to shrink models, but do no enforce minimality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • none : Ss

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              none: Do not use UF with cardinality to shrink model sizes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --eager-arith-bv-conv.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    --uf-ss-abort-card.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Quant.InstWhen :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instantiation modes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • full : InstWhen

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                full: Run instantiation round at full effort, before theory combination.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • fullDelay : InstWhen

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                full-delay.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Run instantiation round at full effort, before theory combination, after all other theories have finished.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • fullLastCall : InstWhen

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                full-last-call.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate running instantiation rounds at full effort and last call. In other words, interleave instantiation and theory combination (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • fullDelayLastCall : InstWhen

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                full-delay-last-call.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate running instantiation rounds at full effort after all other theories have finished, and last call.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • lastCall : InstWhen

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                last-call.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Run instantiation at last call effort, after theory combination and and theories report sat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Quant.MiniscopeQuant :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Miniscope quantifiers modes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • off : MiniscopeQuant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  off: Do not miniscope quantifiers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • conj : MiniscopeQuant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  conj: Use miniscoping of conjunctions only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • fv : MiniscopeQuant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  fv: Use free variable miniscoping only.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • conjAndFv : MiniscopeQuant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  conj-and-fv: Enable both conjunction and free variable miniscoping (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • agg : MiniscopeQuant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  agg.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Enable aggressive miniscope, which further may rewrite quantified formulas into a form where miniscoping is possible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • min : TriggerSel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          min: Consider only minimal subterms that meet criteria for triggers (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • max : TriggerSel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          min-s-max.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Consider only minimal subterms that meet criteria for single triggers, maximal otherwise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • minSAll : TriggerSel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          min-s-all.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Consider only minimal subterms that meet criteria for single triggers, all otherwise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • all : TriggerSel

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          all: Consider all subterms that meet criteria for triggers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Quant.UserPat :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Values of --user-pat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              These modes determine how user provided patterns (triggers) are used during E-matching. The modes vary on when instantiation based on user-provided triggers is combined with instantiation based on automatically selected triggers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • use : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Use both user-provided and auto-generated patterns when patterns are provided for a quantified formula.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • trust : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                trust.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When provided, use only user-provided patterns for a quantified formula (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • strict : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                strict.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When provided, use only user-provided patterns for a quantified formula, and do not use any other instantiation techniques.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • resort : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                resort: Use user-provided patterns only after auto-generated patterns saturate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • ignore : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ignore: Ignore user-provided patterns.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • interleave : UserPat

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                interleave: Alternate between use/resort.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Instances For
