                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Quant :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • enumInst : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --enum-inst.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Enumerative instantiation: instantiate with ground terms from relevant domain, then arbitrary ground terms before answering unknown.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • fullSaturateQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --full-saturate-quant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Resort to full effort techniques instead of answering unknown due to limited quantifier reasoning. Currently enables enumerative instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • printInst : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --print-inst: Print format for printing instantiations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cbqi : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cbqi: Enable conflict-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cbqiAllConflict : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cbqi-all-conflict.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Add all available conflicting instances during conflict-based instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cbqiMode : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cbqi-mode: What effort to apply conflict find mechanism.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cegqi : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cegqi: Turns on counterexample-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cegqiBv : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cegqi-bv.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Use word-level inversion approach for counterexample-guided quantifier instantiation for bit-vectors.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cegqiInnermost : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cegqi-innermost.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Only process innermost quantified formulas in counterexample-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cegqiMidpoint : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cegqi-midpoint.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Choose substitutions based on midpoints of lower and upper bounds for counterexample-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • cegqiNestedQe : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --cegqi-nested-qe.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Process nested quantified formulas with quantifier elimination in counterexample-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • eMatching : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --e-matching: Whether to do heuristic E-matching.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • elimTautQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --elim-taut-quant: Eliminate tautological disjuncts of quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • enumInstInterleave : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --enum-inst-interleave: Interleave enumerative instantiation with other techniques.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • enumInstSum : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --enum-inst-sum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Enumerating tuples of quantifiers by increasing the sum of indices, rather than the maximum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • extRewriteQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --ext-rewrite-quant: Apply extended rewriting to bodies of quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • finiteModelFind : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --finite-model-find: Use finite model finding heuristic for quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • fmfBound : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --fmf-bound: Finite model finding on bounded quantification.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • fmfTypeCompletionThresh : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --fmf-type-completion-thresh.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The maximum cardinality of an interpreted type for which exhaustive enumeration in finite model finding is attempted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ieval : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --ieval: Mode for using instantiation evaluation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • instLocal : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --inst-local: Instantiations are local to the SAT context.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • instMaxRounds : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --inst-max-rounds: Maximum number of instantiation rounds (-1 == no limit, default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • instNoEntail : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --inst-no-entail.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Do not consider instances of quantified formulas that are currently entailed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • instWhen : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --inst-when: When to apply instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • iteLiftQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --ite-lift-quant: Ite lifting mode for quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • macrosQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --macros-quant: Perform quantifiers macro expansion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • macrosQuantMode : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --macros-quant-mode: Mode for quantifiers macro expansion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • mbqi : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --mbqi: Use model-based quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • mbqiCheckTimeout : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --mbqi-check-timeout.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Timeout (in milliseconds) for verifying subcalls for model-based instantiation (0 == no limit).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • mbqiEnum : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --mbqi-enum: Use fast enumeration to augment instantiations from MBQI.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • mbqiOneInstPerRound : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --mbqi-one-inst-per-round: Only add one instantiation per quantifier per round for mbqi.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • miniscopeQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --miniscope-quant: Miniscope mode for quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • miniscopeQuantUser : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --miniscope-quant-user: Miniscope quantified formulas with user patterns.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • multiTriggerCache : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --multi-trigger-cache: Caching version of multi triggers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • multiTriggerLinear : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --multi-trigger-linear.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Implementation of multi triggers where maximum number of instantiations is linear wrt number of ground terms.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • multiTriggerPriority : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --multi-trigger-priority.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Only try multi triggers if single triggers give no instantiations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • multiTriggerWhenSingle : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --multi-trigger-when-single: Select multi triggers when single triggers exist.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • preSkolemQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --pre-skolem-quant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Modes to apply skolemization eagerly to bodies of quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • prenexQuantUser : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --prenex-quant-user: Prenex quantified formulas with user patterns.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • printInstFull : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --print-inst-full: Print instantiations for formulas that do not have given identifiers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • alphaEquiv : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --quant-alpha-equiv: Infer alpha equivalence between quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • dsplit : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --quant-dsplit: Mode for dynamic quantifiers splitting.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • relevantTriggers : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --relevant-triggers: Prefer triggers that are more relevant based on SInE style analysis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • subCbqi : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --sub-cbqi: Enable conflict-based instantiation subsolver strategy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • termDbMode : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --term-db-mode: Which ground terms to consider for instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • triggerSel : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --trigger-sel: Selection mode for triggers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • userPat : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --user-pat: Policy for handling user-provided patterns for quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • varElimQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --var-elim-quant: Enable simple variable elimination for quantified formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • varEntEqElimQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --var-ent-eq-elim-quant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Enable variable elimination for quantified formulas that infers entailed equalities corresponding to eliminations.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • varIneqElimQuant : Quant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      --var-ineq-elim-quant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Enable variable elimination based on infinite projection of unbound arithmetic variables.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.Fair :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Modes for enforcing fairness for counterexample guided quantifier instantion.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • direct : Fair

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                direct: Enforce fairness using direct conflict lemmas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • dtSize : Fair

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                dt-size: Enforce fairness using size operator (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • dtHeightBound : Fair

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                dt-height-bound: Enforce fairness by height bound predicate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • dtSizeBound : Fair

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                dt-size-bound: Enforce fairness by size bound predicate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • none : Fair

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                none: Do not enforce fairness.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.CegisSample :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Modes for sampling with counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • none : CegisSample

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  none: Do not use sampling with CEGIS (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • use : CegisSample

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use sampling to accelerate CEGIS. This will rule out solutions for a conjecture when they are not satisfied by a sample point.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • trust : CegisSample

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  trust.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Trust that when a solution for a conjecture is always true under sampling, then it is indeed a solution. Note this option may print out spurious solutions for synthesis conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.Enum :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Modes for sygus enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • smart : Enum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        smart: Use smart enumeration based on datatype constraints.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • fast : Enum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        fast: Use optimized enumerator for sygus enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • random : Enum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        random: Use basic random enumerator for sygus enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • varAgnostic : Enum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        var-agnostic: Use sygus solver to enumerate terms that are agnostic to variables.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • auto : Enum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        auto: Internally decide the best policy for each enumerator (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.EvalUnfold :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Modes for sygus evaluation unfolding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • none : EvalUnfold

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              none: Do not use sygus evaluation unfolding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • single : EvalUnfold

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              single: Do single-step unfolding for all evaluation functions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • singleBool : EvalUnfold

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              single-bool.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Do single-step unfolding for Boolean functions and ITEs, and multi-step unfolding for all others (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • multi : EvalUnfold

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              multi: Do multi-step unfolding for all evaluation functions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.GrammarCons :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Modes for default SyGuS grammars.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • simple : GrammarCons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    simple: Use simple grammar construction (no symbolic terms or constants) (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • anyConst : GrammarCons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    any-const: Use symoblic constant constructors.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • anyTerm : GrammarCons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    any-term.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When applicable, use constructors corresponding to any symbolic term. This option enables a sum-of-monomials grammar for arithmetic. For all other types, it enables symbolic constant constructors.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • anyTermConcise : GrammarCons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    any-term-concise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    When applicable, use constructors corresponding to any symbolic term, favoring conciseness over generality. This option is equivalent to any-term but enables a polynomial grammar for arithmetic when not in a combined theory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Modes for single invocation techniques.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • none : Si

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      none: Do not use single invocation techniques (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • use : Si

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use: Use single invocation techniques only if grammar is not restrictive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • all : Si

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      all: Always use single invocation techniques.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.SiRcons :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Modes for reconstruction solutions while using single invocation techniques.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • none : SiRcons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            none.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Do not try to reconstruct solutions in the original (user-provided) grammar when using single invocation techniques. In this mode, solutions produced by cvc5 may violate grammar restrictions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • try : SiRcons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            try.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Try to reconstruct solutions in the original grammar when using single invocation techniques in an incomplete (fail-fast) manner.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • allLimit : SiRcons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            all-limit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Try to reconstruct solutions in the original grammar, but terminate if a maximum number of rounds for reconstruction is exceeded.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • all : SiRcons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            all.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Try to reconstruct solutions in the original grammar. In this mode, we do not terminate until a solution is successfully reconstructed (the default).
