                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus.UnifPi :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Modes for piecewise-independent unification.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • none : UnifPi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  none: Do not use piecewise-independent unification (the default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • complete : UnifPi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  complete.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use complete approach for piecewise-independent unification (see Section 3 of Barbosa et al FMCAD 2019).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • condEnum : UnifPi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  cond-enum.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Use unconstrained condition enumeration for piecewise-independent unification (see Section 4 of Barbosa et al FMCAD 2019).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • condEnumIgain : UnifPi

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  cond-enum-igain.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Same as cond-enum, but additionally uses an information gain heuristic when doing decision tree learning.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      inductive Cvc.Solver.Option.Sygus :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Syntax-guided synthesis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • abortSize : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-abort-size.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Tells enumerative sygus to only consider solutions up to term size N (-1 == no limit, default).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • fair : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-fair: If and how to apply fairness for sygus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • rewriter : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-rewriter: If and how to apply rewriting for sygus symmetry breaking.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • simpleSymBreak : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-simple-sym-break.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        If and how to apply simple symmetry breaking based on the grammar for smart enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • symBreakPbe : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-sym-break-pbe: Sygus symmetry breaking lemmas based on pbe conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • cegisSample : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --cegis-sample.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Mode for using samples in the counterexample-guided inductive synthesis loop.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • sygus : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus: Support SyGuS commands.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • addConstGrammar : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-add-const-grammar: Statically add constants appearing in conjecture to grammars.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • coreConnective : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-core-connective.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Use unsat core analysis to construct Boolean connective to sygus conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • enum : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-enum: Mode for sygus enumeration.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • evalUnfold : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-eval-unfold: Modes for sygus evaluation unfolding.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • grammarCons : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-grammar-cons: Mode for SyGuS grammar construction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • inst : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-inst: Enable SyGuS instantiation quantifiers module.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • invTempl : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-inv-templ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Template mode for sygus invariant synthesis (weaken pre-condition, strengthen post-condition, or none).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • minGrammar : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-min-grammar: Statically minimize sygus grammars.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • out : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-out: Output mode for sygus.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • pbe : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-pbe.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Enable approach which unifies conditional solutions, specialized for programming-by-examples (pbe) conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • repairConst : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-repair-const: Use approach to repair constants in sygus candidate solutions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • si : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-si: Mode for processing single invocation synthesis conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • siAbort : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-si-abort: Abort if synthesis conjecture is not single invocation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • siRcons : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-si-rcons: Policy for reconstructing solutions for single invocation conjectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • stream : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-stream.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Enumerate a stream of solutions instead of terminating after the first one.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • unifPi : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-unif-pi: Mode for synthesis via piecewise-indepedent unification.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • verifyTimeout : Sygus

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        --sygus-verify-timeout.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Timeout (in milliseconds) for verifying satisfiability of synthesized terms (0 == no limit).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                inductive Cvc.Solver.Option :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A solver option, by category.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • base (opt : Base) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Resource limits, verbosity, statistics and incrementality.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • smt (opt : Smt) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The SMT layer: what a check can produce, self-checks, preprocessing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • printing (opt : Printing) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  How terms and models are printed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • proof (opt : Proof) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Proof production and checking.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sat (opt : Sat) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The SAT layer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • theory (opt : Theory) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The theory layer, shared by every theory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • arith (opt : Arith) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The arithmetic theory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • arrays (opt : Arrays) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The theory of arrays.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • bv (opt : Bv) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The bit-vector theory.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • strings (opt : Strings) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The theory of strings and sequences.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • uf (opt : Uf) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Uninterpreted functions.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • quant (opt : Quant) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Quantifier instantiation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • sygus (opt : Sygus) : Option

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Syntax-guided synthesis.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            def Cvc.Solver.Option.toStrings (opt : Option) (v : opt.argType) :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            String × String

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The flag and the value to hand cvc5's string-based setOption.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Equations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • opt.toStrings v = (opt.name, opt.valueString v)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Instances For

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Every option at the top level #

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              One abbreviation per option, named after its category and itself, so that .smt_produceModels stands for .smt .produceModels wherever an Option is expected, patterns included.
